'''Lena''' (Japanese: '''レナ''' ''Rena'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[XY016|A Jolting Switcheroo!]]''.

She and her younger sister [[Lyn]] were resting at the same [[Pokémon Center]] as {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. Unbeknownst to any of them, Lyn's bag, which contained a {{p|Pichu}} she had been caring for, was accidentally switched with {{an|Bonnie}}'s bag, which contained {{TP|Clemont|Dedenne}}. As she and Lyn left and were walking down the street, Lyn noticed Dedenne was in her bag instead of Pichu. While Lena was busy talking with a friend, Lyn ran off to find Pichu. As she ended her conversation, Lena found out that Lyn was gone, became worried, and started searching for her.

Meanwhile, Ash and his friends were looking for Dedenne. {{an|Clemont}} came up with the idea to use one of his inventions to lure Dedenne to them. The invention exploded, however, but the explosion was noticed by Lena, who quickly rushed to the scene. There, she found the group, and Pichu, much to her relief. The group explained the situation to Lena, and Lena told them that she suspected Dedenne was with Lyn. Now searching for Lyn and Dedenne, the group and Lena eventually found them in a grape orchard, about to be attacked by a horde of wild {{p|Beedrill}}. [[Ash's Pikachu]] saved them in the nick of time, and Lena was reunited with Lyn. Then, the entire group decided to have dinner together.

While resting at a [[Pokémon Center]], Lyn's bag, which contained Pichu, was accidentally switched with {{an|Bonnie}}'s bag, which contained {{TP|Clemont|Dedenne}}. Lyn found this out as she was walking down the street with Lena. Lyn ran off to find Pichu, much to Lena's worry.

{{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, who now had Pichu with them, were in turn looking for Dedenne. Clemont came up with the idea to use one of his inventions to lure Dedenne to them. The invention eventually exploded, and this was noticed by Lena, who quickly rushed to the scene. Lena was happy to find Pichu with the group, and joined them in their quest to find Lyn and Dedenne. They eventually found them in a grape orchard, about to be attacked by a horde of wild {{p|Beedrill}}. Pikachu drove the Beedrill away with {{m|Thunderbolt}} and Pichu reunited with Lyn.

Pichu's only known move is {{m|Thunder Shock}}.}}
